title: 3rd Stopping Place 2nd Truth In Sum The Indication Of Mercifulness To Unity And Oneness

questions.question: What two ideas does the passage say the truth of Mercifulness shows?
questions.answer: It shows that the Creator is one, and that His oneness appears within the wide unity of creation.

questions.question: How is the truth of Opening described in relation to all beings?
questions.answer: It is presented as bringing out and unfolding the orderly forms of all created things in a way that covers everything.

questions.question: What feature of mercy is emphasized in the care of living creatures?
questions.answer: Mercy cares for all living beings as they enter worldly life and provides what they need in an orderly way.

questions.question: Which group among living beings is given special attention in the passage?
questions.answer: Those who have just newly come into life are especially mentioned.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the delivery of necessities to living beings?
questions.answer: It says their needs are brought to them completely, without any being left out.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by saying mercy forgets none of them?
questions.answer: It teaches that divine care reaches every individual and misses no one.

questions.question: Why is the truth of Mercifulness said to be comprehensive?
questions.answer: Because it extends to all things and all living beings, not just a small part of creation.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the connection between life beginning and mercy?
questions.answer: When living things come into the world, mercy meets them with provision and care from the start.

questions.question: What happens to the traveller at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: He recognizes and witnesses another proof, called the Third Truth, at the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What main claim is made about the truth of Opening?
questions.answer: Its all-encompassing order in forming created things clearly points to divine unity.

questions.question: What part of creation is used as evidence in this passage: lifeless matter, living beings, or human society?
questions.answer: Living beings are used as the main evidence.

questions.question: At what stage of a living being’s existence is mercy especially highlighted?
questions.answer: It is especially highlighted when living beings first come into this world.

questions.question: What does the passage imply about the source of provision for creatures?
questions.answer: Their provision comes through a deliberate mercy that knows and supplies every need.

questions.question: Why is the phrase about forgetting none of them important?
questions.answer: It shows completeness, meaning no creature is neglected or outside divine care.

questions.question: What does simultaneous mercy toward individuals everywhere help prove?
questions.answer: It helps prove both divine unity and divine oneness working throughout creation.

questions.question: How does the passage connect wide coverage and precise care?
questions.answer: It presents mercy as reaching all things broadly while also serving each individual exactly.

questions.question: What is the effect of the final sentence about the traveller?
questions.answer: It marks a transition, showing that after seeing this proof he moves on to witness another truth.

questions.question: Why would this passage strengthen a believer’s trust in Allah’s care?
questions.answer: Because it describes a mercy that reaches every living being with perfect order and no neglect.

questions.question: Summarize the central message of the passage in one sentence.
questions.answer: The passage teaches that the universal and perfectly ordered care given to all living beings proves the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the truth of Opening and the truth of Mercifulness?
questions.answer: Both are shown as clear signs of unity because both work everywhere with order and completeness.

questions.question: What does the unfolding of forms show according to the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that creation happens through a single ordered will.

questions.question: What does nurturing all animate beings show according to the passage?
questions.answer: It shows a mercy that embraces all life and points to one caring Lord.

questions.question: How are newborn or newly appearing creatures treated in the argument?
questions.answer: They are presented as strong evidence because they receive exactly what they need right as they begin life.

questions.question: What role do necessities play in the passage’s proof?
questions.answer: The fact that needs arrive properly and fully is used as evidence of intentional mercy and control.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that mercy reaches all individuals in all places at the same time?
questions.answer: To show that this care belongs to One whose action is not limited by place or number.

questions.question: Who is the observer in the final sentence, and what does he do?
questions.answer: The traveller is the observer, and he witnesses the next truth in his journey.

questions.question: What lesson about Allah’s relationship to creation can students take from this passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s care is vast enough for all creation and precise enough for every single living being.

questions.question: According to the passage, what makes the proof from Mercifulness strong?
questions.answer: Its care covers all living beings, works with perfect order, and leaves none without what is needed.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying Mercifulness encompasses all things?
questions.answer: It means mercy is not limited to one place or one type of creature but extends throughout creation.

questions.question: What is one sign of mercy in the lives of animate beings?
questions.answer: They are nurtured and provided for as they come into worldly life.

questions.question: Why are order and regularity mentioned together in the care of creatures?
questions.answer: They stress that this care is measured, dependable, and purposeful.

questions.question: What does the arrival of necessities reveal about the nature of divine care?
questions.answer: It reveals that divine care is attentive, complete, and timely.

questions.question: How does the passage rule out neglect in creation?
questions.answer: It says no individual is overlooked when mercy provides for living beings.

questions.question: What is shown by mercy reaching every individual at once across different places?
questions.answer: It shows a power and mercy that are universal and undivided.

questions.question: How does the passage blend the universal and the personal?
questions.answer: It speaks of mercy covering everything while also meeting each creature’s own needs.

questions.question: What conclusion is the reader expected to draw from this pattern of care?
questions.answer: That the One who sustains life everywhere is uniquely one.

questions.question: What does the mention of the Third Truth do structurally?
questions.answer: It closes one proof and opens the way to the next stage of reflection.

questions.question: What truth is the focus of this passage?
questions.answer: The focus is the truth of Mercifulness.

questions.question: What earlier truth is briefly used for comparison?
questions.answer: The truth of Opening is used for comparison.

questions.question: What does the passage say the ordered shaping of beings proves?
questions.answer: It proves unity in a way that is extremely clear.

questions.question: What activity of mercy is highlighted toward animate beings?
questions.answer: Mercy raises, nourishes, and supports them when they enter life in this world.

questions.question: Which creatures are specially pointed out as examples of this care?
questions.answer: Newly arrived living beings are specially pointed out.

questions.question: How complete is the provision described in the passage?
questions.answer: It is complete enough that none of the creatures’ needs are left out.

questions.question: What can be inferred from the fact that mercy forgets no one?
questions.answer: The One behind that mercy knows every creature and is able to care for all of them.

questions.question: How does the passage use observation of life as a path to belief?
questions.answer: It points to visible patterns in living things and draws spiritual conclusions from them.

questions.question: What is the traveller’s role in the final line?
questions.answer: He is the one who notices this proof and then moves on to the next truth.

questions.question: In the passage, what does the truth of Mercifulness do besides showing compassion?
questions.answer: It also serves as a proof of Allah’s unity and unique oneness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the truth of Opening in simple terms?
questions.answer: It is the bringing forth of the orderly forms of created things.

questions.question: What shared quality makes both Opening and Mercifulness evidence for unity?
questions.answer: Both operate universally with clear order and completeness.

questions.question: Who receives the nurturing mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: All living beings that come into the life of this world receive it.

questions.question: What does the phrase about necessities reaching them suggest about timing?
questions.answer: It suggests their needs are met promptly and appropriately.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying none are forgotten?
questions.answer: Every creature is included in divine care without exception.

questions.question: What deeper meaning comes from mercy acting in all places at the same moment?
questions.answer: It points to a single divine action that is not divided or weakened by distance or numbers.

questions.question: What balance does the passage maintain between many creatures and one source?
questions.answer: It shows countless creatures being cared for while tracing that care back to one Lord.

questions.question: What narrative movement happens at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The traveller finishes witnessing this sign and arrives at the next truth.
